title: Subject/Keyword
description: A structured subject term with optional controlled vocabulary linkage. Aligns with DataCite Subject (property 6). Supports free-text keywords and terms from controlled vocabularies like MeSH, Cognitive Atlas, or Library of Congress Subject Headings.

term.description: The subject term or keyword text.

subject_scheme.description: Name of the controlled vocabulary or classification scheme (e.g., 'MeSH', 'Cognitive Atlas', 'LCSH', 'Fields of Science and Technology (FOS)').

value_uri.description: URI identifying this specific subject term within the scheme.

classification_code.description: Classification code within the scheme (e.g., MeSH tree number, ANZSRC code). Use when the scheme does not provide per-term URIs.
